value.name: receives Rosa's text update
value.description: Asha's phone lights up with a message from Rosa saying the papers are notarized and she is heading home.
evidence: her phone lit on the table: Rosa, three lines, papers are notarized, heading home now.

value.name: sets phone aside and resumes writing
value.description: Asha reads the message, puts the phone face down, and returns to her writing with a brief sense of focus.
evidence: Asha read it, set the phone face down, and went back to the paragraph
for a moment the dining table felt smaller, the Trenton end of the week folded shut enough that she could keep her eyes on the screen.

value.name: leaves revision unfinished
value.description: Asha decides the revised sentence still does not fit but leaves it on the page and moves on.
evidence: The revised sentence still did not quite fit, and she left it on the page anyway and moved to the next one.

value.name: reviews transferred work items
value.description: Asha closes the draft and opens the paralegal's email to inspect the list of work that has been moved under her name since Tuesday.
evidence: Asha left the half-revised paragraph mid-sentence and closed the blank document, then opened the paralegal's email and began clicking through the list of everything that had moved under her name since Tuesday:

value.name: finds unfamiliar legal documents
value.description: She recognizes some items but discovers others she has never seen, including a discovery response and two letters to opposing counsel.
evidence: a continuance request she recognized, a discovery response she did not, two letters to opposing counsel she had never seen drafted.

value.name: realizes unfamiliar items exceed her grasp
value.description: Asha reads the dates and initials and feels the number of unfamiliar documents become too many to honestly treat as her own work.
evidence: She read down the column of dates and initials and felt the count of unfamiliar items grow past what she could plausibly absorb as her own without lying outright.

value.name: steps away for water
value.description: Overwhelmed, Asha pushes the laptop away, stands up, and goes to the counter for water.
evidence: After the fourth document she pushed the laptop a few inches away, stood, and walked to the counter for water;

value.name: stares at untouched water
value.description: Asha fills a glass but forgets to drink it, instead staring at the water as the kitchen light catches the rim.
evidence: she filled the glass and then forgot to drink it, looking instead at the level sitting still inside the glass while the kitchen light caught the rim.

value.name: delays returning to work
value.description: Back at the table, Asha lets the dimmed screen remain untouched for a moment before forcing herself to continue.
